shortDescription.default: Plan and track SharePoint content in month, week, and list views.

longDescription.default: Give content authors a central calendar for SharePoint Site Pages. Review content in month, week, and list views, filter by publishing status, reserve dates with local placeholders, and create draft pages directly from the calendar.

features.title: Content Calendar
features.description: Deploys the Content Calendar web part for planning and tracking SharePoint content.
